bound.payload_counted: catalogs.EncodeCatalogPayload of each restored observation, summed in input order

root_cause: runtime/acquisition_compaction.go appendReplayMetadata drops a metadata observation only when three consecutive observations are byte-identical. models.dev changes between runs, so every distinct snapshot stays in the retained history.
Each promotion adds one models.dev snapshot of 7 to 8.5 MB. The accepted history reached 66.4 MB of decoded payload after promotion #241 and crossed the 64 MiB replay bound after re-encoding.

PrepareAcquisitionReplay replays the full history before it compacts, and compactAcquisitionHistory applies the same bound before it selects. A history over the bound can never compact, so every later run fails on the same accepted checkpoint.
The workflow records the failure as unclassified because the error field is replay.observations, not publication_admission.*.
